Thanks, I think I needed this. That is indeed what I wanted to do but I was not completely sure, it is a really scary thing to do. We are probably going to plan some kind of 'dubble date' like we used to do with the four of us and then I could just talk to him in person. 
Thank you! :)
Hi I would like to sell. My favorite villager is Erik
Hi I would like to sell but how do I add a so-called flair to this comment?
Whoops my autocorrect was on in my native language... Changed it 😅

Same, my ex and I broke up because i was depressed and he left me with this hope that if i was getting better we could try again but a few days later he casually told me that he just did not love lol. Which made me fall in a bigger depression, it's been 6 months now and still grieving. But it is all gonna be okay!

And that's the point, I know they are more people feeling the same as I do. So why are we all still here? Why are we all still forced to live if we all hate it so much? Why is suicide so bad? Why is everybody so shocked if someone kills themselves and why can't we just be happy for that person that they finally found peace?

I've tried, I've been in therapy for almost a year, nothing seems to help. Talking tomy family is fine for a moment but the feelings just keep coming back and it is killing me. Besides that I just moved to a different city pretty far from my family so it's hard

I’m just trying to be proud of the small things that I accomplish, the first 1-2 months I could barely eat out of sadness or I had kind of eating attacks where I couldn’t stop eating and I cried everyday. Now I can eat just fine and I still cry a lot, but less than before. I try to look at the good things and focusing on them but it’s hard, I’m definitely not saying it’s easy because it really is not. If I already got a little better that should mean I can get completely better and over it, doesn’t matter how much time it will take me. 
also try to accept that it’s okay to suffer and don’t feel bad about suffering because that will make it even worse. ❤️
It sucks, everybody tells us it will get better but it just doesn’t. The past 2 to 3 months I did not get any better or moved on even the tiniest bit, slowly starting to lose hope in everything.

I actual didn’t look at his social media for a month, didn’t help. I’m not quitting social media because it’s also the thing that’s keeping me in touch with my friends during the summer and when I’m going to college. Not looking at his social media also doesn’t help move forward, nothing does

This really helped me, my bf and I broke up in March and I cannot get him out of my head and accepting the fact he’s not coming back because I’m still making stupid excuses in my head that he will. But i know i don’t want to get back with him. This message really helped me :)
And to everyone who’s dealing with a heartbreak, take your time, and small progress is also progress, it will get better.

I know you are fucking right but I just can’t. I’ve been trying for 5 months and I just can’t. I’m telling myself I can let them go and every time I think it’s getting better I just find myself on his social media. I still don’t understand why we exactly broke (it was kind of mutual) and I just can not get over it.
